{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABbWhvwQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhE7Jwk", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 73, "title": "Normalize PMX texture path separators for Android Chrome (direct MMDLoader comparison)", "body": "## Reported failure and confirmed source-level issue

Android Chrome fails to load the public Uka comparison, whereas macOS Chrome loads it. **Exact user-reported error**:

```text
Could not load/render the comparison: Error: PMX resource failed: /mmd-gltf/uka/tex\hair_s01.png
```

The pinned and deployed asset is **/mmd-gltf/uka/tex/hair_s01.png** (forward slashes): see [Uka source manifest](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/uka-manifest.json). The failed path shown mixes `/` and `\\`.

**Important qualification:** the inconsistent string construction is confirmed in the code, but the precise cause of the Android load failure is not yet proven. For HTTP(S), a browser URL parser can sometimes treat backslashes as slashes; a failed image fetch/decode can still display the original input string. `hair_s01.png` is ~12.3 MB compressed, so Android memory/decode pressure remains a separate possibility. Test the *actual resolved request URL* and response before claiming a fix.

## Root cause and intended ownership

- The left **MMD** pane loads the original Uka PMX through `new MMDLoader(manager).loadAsync(...)` from `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.2` ([examples/main.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts)). LoadingManager reports `PMX resource failed` with the URL supplied by the loader.
- The shared library [`takahirox/three-mmd-loader/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts` (MaterialBuilder._loadTexture)](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts#L1466-L1522) currently constructs non-default-toon paths with **`fullPath = this.resourcePath + filePath`**, without canonicalizing Windows-style `\\` separators.
- In contrast, the glTF conversion code [tools/prepare-uka.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/prepare-uka.ts) and [tools/pmx-to-gltf.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/pmx-to-gltf.ts) already replace backslashes with forward slashes. **The recorded Uka inventory also normalizes the filenames before recording them**, so a forward-slash inventory is not proof that the raw PMX uses only forward slashes.
- Fix **the reusable upstream library first**, then update this repo's pinned dependency/lockfile and demo. If release timing requires a narrow workaround, document it, test it, and do not leave the root upstream bug unaddressed. No rewriting or redistributing modified original Uka PMX/image files.

## Implementation handoff

- [ ] Verify the exact raw PMX texture filename for Uka's hair, and trace `MMDLoader` → `MaterialBuilder._loadTexture` → resolved URL → `LoadingManager.onError` on Android. Record canonical request URL, HTTP status and/or image decode failure; do not infer a 404 solely from the displayed path.
- [ ] Normalize PMX/PMD **relative resource filenames** (backslashes and mixed separators) to portable URL paths **before** joining them with `resourcePath`, selecting loader/handler, caching, loading and emitting diagnostics. Support examples `tex\\hair_s01.png`, `tex/hair_s01.png` and mixed forms. Avoid double slashes or broken base URLs, non-ASCII filenames and percent encoding. Preserve valid absolute URLs, `data:` URLs and built-in default toon textures.
- [ ] Apply consistent semantics to base textures, sphere/subtextures and custom toon textures. Preserve original source names and bytes independently from normalized fetch URLs.
- [ ] Validate relative path segments including traversal attempts after separator conversion; do not allow a `..\\` source path to evade existing root restrictions or break security boundaries.
- [ ] Update `@takahirox/three-mmd` to the corrected upstream release (package.json + lockfile), or use an explicitly scoped compatibility shim pending release. Do not silently patch vendor code inside node_modules.
- [ ] Preserve meaningful failure/Retry handling: an actual 404, browser request error or decode failure should be diagnosable without labelling every failure as a malformed path.
- [ ] Add unit/integration tests of Windows-style, POSIX-style, mixed paths, Unicode/spaces, duplicates/cache, relative paths and traversal rejection. Verify the **actual requested URL** uses **/mmd-gltf/uka/tex/hair_s01.png**, not only that a displayed error message is rewritten.
- [ ] Extend [tests/browser/uka.spec.ts](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tests/browser/uka.spec.ts) with the real pinned Uka source. Assert both MMD/glTF panes reach Ready and texture/image paths are canonical. Keep the existing missing-image/Retry test.
- [ ] Reproduce cold/warm loads in **real Android Chrome**, noting Android/Chrome version, response status, image decode success, and exact request paths. If no physical Android test environment is available, explicitly state that and provide manual verification steps. Desktop Chromium at a narrow viewport is not proof of Android compatibility.
- [ ] If Android still fails with a canonical URL and successful response, investigate image memory/decode resource exhaustion separately, without claiming that normalization alone fixed the issue.
- [ ] Keep multi-motion single-glTF playback, Uka/Gene IK, existing licenses and unmodified pinned assets, mobile layout, and comparison synchronization intact. Run `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, relevant Playwright suites, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Report passes/failures/skips.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Direct-PMX resource requests use forward-slash canonical URLs, including for the pinned Uka `tex\\hair_s01.png` case; all relevant texture families work and retain original names/bytes.
- [ ] Test assertions inspect the network request URL, not only error string formatting, and cover malformed/unsafe relative paths.
- [ ] Both panes load with successful responses, Retry works after deliberate failure, and no regressions appear in Gene Light or motion/IK controls.
- [ ] The outcome on actual Android Chrome is **verified**, or explicitly marked unverified with a reproducible test plan. If canonicalization is insufficient, document the remaining cause as a follow-up rather than assert success.

## References

- [Uka manifest](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/uka-manifest.json)
- [Upstream three-mmd-loader](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts)
- [Demo MMDLoader / LoadingManager](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts)
- [Source transport policy](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/source-transport.md)

## Required post-merge verification

Check real Android Chrome cold-cache/warm-cache loads with canonical hair texture request. If device access is unavailable, leave Android-specific acceptance open and report the limitation.
